evals.prompt: Set up one-command run scripts for all my connected phones in this Flutter project.
evals.expected_output: Runs setup.mjs detection, shows the detected Android/iOS/macOS ids, writes scripts/lib.sh, run_all.sh and build_release.sh with those ids, runs bash -n on them, and asks before executing run_all.sh.

evals.prompt: Add a build_release script like run_all to ./my_app. It has a debug applicationIdSuffix.
evals.expected_output: Detects androidDebugId as the id plus '.debug' and androidId as the plain id; the debug launch uses the suffixed id and the release launch the plain one.

evals.prompt: Generate the device scripts again, scripts/ already has run_all.sh.
evals.expected_output: Does not overwrite existing files; reports them as skipped and asks the user before re-running with --force.
